cohort: 10,252 women undergoing frozen-thawed cycles with single blastocyst transfer between January 2016 and December 2019.
finding: While BMI did not significantly affect pregnancy or live birth chances, obesity increased miscarriage risk, underweight was associated with better maternal and neonatal outcomes, and overweight and obesity were associated with worse outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found that obese women had a higher incidence of cesarean delivery compared to normal-weight women.
